cases.name: parallel-not-serial
cases.prompt: Audit these four packages for license issues.
expect: spawns four subagents in one block
one brief per package, no shared state between them
does not run them one at a time

cases.name: no-subagent-for-one-read
cases.prompt: What does the Makefile's test target run?

cases.name: brief-has-four-parts
cases.prompt: Have subagents compare two auth libraries.
expect: each brief states objective, output format, boundaries, and facts
names the files or docs to read
states the acceptance check or says there is none

cases.name: second-opinion-with-context
cases.prompt: The small model has failed twice on the flaky test. What now?
expect: asks a stronger model instead of retrying the same one
passes the original objective, attempts, exact failure, files, and constraints
names the subagent as Role: work (Model)
